decision: Do not accept the closure. The job was marked complete and closed on 04/07/2024 (event-039, event-043) although the only confirmed visit was 08/07/2024 (event-028), no provider work result is on file, the invoice correspondence names a company other than the instructed provider (event-032), the recorded amount (£49.40 incl VAT, event-037) matches neither quoted option (£35 + VAT / £90 + VAT, event-019), and another tenant's name and phone appear to have been sent to the provider (event-024 vs event-013/029/030). I moved no money and made no liability decision (PRO-PAYMENTS, PRO-TENANT-LIABILITY).
